reference.lighting: matched legacy hemisphere and directional light; no shadows or atmosphere
reference.geometry: actual native terrain columns and native plant cells; no display LOD
reference.scope: bounded exact primary visibility; optional32m local hard shadows, terrain shadows clipped to crop; not full-world lighting or real-time FPS benchmark

walk.scope: Actual X11 walking or stationary full yaw/pitch inputs and 20 FPS child-window recording; normal startup unless an explicit settle delay is given. Recording perturbs timings; inspect synchronized game.json observations and benchmark separately. Mouse turn delivery depends on X11 input support.

startup.scope: Actual X11 walking or stationary full yaw/pitch inputs and 20 FPS child-window recording; normal startup unless an explicit settle delay is given. Recording perturbs timings; inspect synchronized game.json observations and benchmark separately. Mouse turn delivery depends on X11 input support.

decision: Compact field is default. Full joint directional generation/storage/upload/shader path only enabled explicitly. Porous height layer remains optional. Local statistical carrier edits and rule-based distant flowers do not preserve all individual far plant identities.

visual_error.scope: Wide ROI contains silhouette/sky geometry error; interior reduces that confound. Stochastic texture phase differs. These statistics are diagnostics, not comprehensive visual quality scores.
